8e67f7ec-67e8-4db6-858e-b11b71011f3c.question: What are the challenges of wind power?
8e67f7ec-67e8-4db6-858e-b11b71011f3c.answer: The main challenges of wind power mentioned are that turbines can be noisy and may negatively affect local wildlife, especially birds and bats.
